macros.name: it
macros.doc: \it{⟨text⟩} expands to ⟨text⟩ and places ⟨text⟩ in italic font.

macros.name: setDefaultStyle
macros.doc: To create a custom default style use \setDefaultStyle.

macros.name: spc
macros.doc: To insert additional ‘hard’ spaces into the data stream, use the \spc command.

macros.name: sub
macros.doc: Subscripts and superscripts are implemented through LaTeX commands \sub and \sup. • \sub{⟨text⟩} expands to <sub>⟨text⟩</sub> and places ⟨text⟩ as a subscript. • \sup{⟨text⟩} expands to <sup>⟨text⟩</sup> and places ⟨text⟩ as a superscript.

macros.name: sup
macros.doc: Subscripts and superscripts are implemented through LaTeX commands \sub and \sup. • \sub{⟨text⟩} expands to <sub>⟨text⟩</sub> and places ⟨text⟩ as a subscript. • \sup{⟨text⟩} expands to <sup>⟨text⟩</sup> and places ⟨text⟩ as a superscript.

macros.name: useDS
macros.doc: When you’ve defined a custom default style using \setDefaultStyle, insert \useDS{⟨name⟩} as the value of the DS key.

macros.name: useRV
macros.doc: The \useRV command expands to the rich string defined by \rtpara and is used as the value of the RV key.

macros.name: useV
macros.doc: The commands \useRV{⟨name⟩} and \useV{⟨name⟩} may also be used to insert the strings into the RV and V keys, respectively; though the richtext package offers an alternative technique.
